scope_note: Seventeen unallocated modeled syntheses remain after the second 2026-09-08 corrective pass: twelve exact same-year Google-plus-Tapaha taxpayer aggregations, one exact tax-year-2027 sum of nine Tapaha real-property parcels, one exact FY2018-FY2025 cumulative City Technology Business abatement total, one source-projection payroll counterfactual, and two noncausal matched-county comparisons. Source-reported water, efficiency, carbon-free-energy, design, emissions, deferred-contract balance, individual parcel values and annual abatements are direct governed records, not models. The abatement total is a non-additive convenience synthesis of eight annual flows; it excludes the separately retained adjacent FY2017 amount and does not resolve the notes' unnamed-taxpayer attribution limitation. The 2027 parcel sum excludes Google business-personal property and is not a tax, payment, investment or continuation of the ACFR taxpayer series. Supplier, electricity-use, utility-bill, tax-receipt, net-fiscal, public-cost, construction-payroll, social-return, remediation-cost and county-GDP candidates remain rejected for explicitly missing project inputs or unstable sensitivity. Status remains gap_closure_in_progress pending independent re-audit.

estimates.label: Original planned annual payroll product

scope.label: Original Google Lenoir campus employment plan

interval.interpretation: Exact product of two source projections; this is not observed payroll and the point interval does not represent statistical certainty.

parameters.name: planned_operating_jobs
parameters.transformation: Multiplied by planned average annual salary

parameters.name: observed_employee_snapshot
parameters.transformation: Diagnostic only; excluded from projected-payroll arithmetic

estimates.confidence_rationale: Arithmetic is exact and same-source, but both inputs are 2007 projections; a state-reported December 2008 snapshot of approximately 50 employees shows the 210-job scale had not been realized then, and no later payroll reconciliation was found.
estimates.decision_relevance: Provides the annual wage-bill scale implicit in the original jobs and salary announcement without relabeling it as realized payroll.

evidence_search.remaining_evidence_gap: Google/NC Commerce/NCGA/City-Caldwell workforce searches for 2007-2026 still lack annual-average FTE, realized wages, benefits, occupations, contractor split and worker residence; the December 2008 count is a point snapshot only.

derivation.formula: 210 planned jobs × $48,300 planned average annual salary = $10,143,000 per year
assumptions: The two projections use a compatible full-build employment scope.
A job is treated as one annual salary position only to reproduce the plan's implicit scale.
The approximately 50-employee December 2008 snapshot is a diagnostic constraint and is not multiplied by the planned salary.
Benefits, equity, contractors, vacancies, turnover and residence effects are excluded.

limitations: Not observed or current Google payroll.
The 210 planned jobs were not realized by the December 2008 snapshot, when the state reported approximately 50 employees and a withdrawn JDIG application.
The source did not define annual-average FTE or compensation components.
Do not add to Deloitte labor-income estimates.
estimates.notes: Retained only as the arithmetic scale implied by the contemporaneous 210-job and $48,300 salary projections after direct workforce/payroll searches; it is a counterfactual announcement product, not observed payroll, and it must not be reconciled to the approximately 50 employees reported in December 2008.

estimates.label: Caldwell County employment gap versus matched counties

interval.interpretation: Envelope across national K3/K10, North Carolina K5, five leave-one-out estimates and 2006/2008 treatment-anchor sensitivities; not a confidence interval or facility effect.

provenance.detail: 2007-anchored equal-weight growth benchmark from five donors

estimates.confidence_rationale: National matched fit is usable but the sensitivity envelope crosses zero and North Carolina-only donors produce a materially larger gap.
estimates.decision_relevance: Shows Caldwell's long-run employment path relative to explicitly selected comparisons without attributing the difference to Google.

evidence_search.remaining_evidence_gap: BLS QCEW/Census 2001-2024 supplies county outcomes but no Google exposure intensity, establishment employment, worker residence, concurrent-shock controls or project-specific causal identification.

assumptions: Treatment chronology uses the May 2008 opening, with 2001-2007 preperiod and 2007 anchor.
Eligible non-study counties have complete 2001-2024 data and 2007 population between 0.35 and 2.5 times Caldwell.
Five lowest pretrend-RMSE donors are 01017, 45067, 37165, 26059 and 39119.
The result is descriptive and not a causal effect.

limitations: Great Recession, furniture-sector decline and later campus expansions confound attribution.
Treatment-anchor sensitivities are 3.7627406203491143 percent for 2006 and 3.4050635887949765 percent for 2008; the latter may already include opening effects.
estimates.notes: Retained as a descriptive county comparison only after direct project-employment searches; not Google jobs and not a causal effect.

estimates.label: Caldwell County wage gap versus matched counties

interval.interpretation: Envelope across national K3/K10, North Carolina K5, five leave-one-out estimates and 2006/2008 treatment-anchor sensitivities; not a confidence interval or facility effect.

provenance.detail: Caldwell County 2024 nominal average weekly wage
2007-anchored equal-weight growth benchmark from five donors

estimates.confidence_rationale: Sensitivity stays positive but nominal county wages span all covered industries and cannot isolate the campus or resident workers.
estimates.decision_relevance: Shows Caldwell's long-run wage path relative to explicit comparisons without treating county wage growth as Google payroll or causation.

evidence_search.remaining_evidence_gap: BLS QCEW/Census 2001-2024 supplies county wages but no Google wage distribution, occupation mix, establishment payroll, worker residence, exposure intensity or project-specific causal design.

assumptions: Treatment chronology uses the May 2008 opening, with 2001-2007 preperiod and 2007 anchor.
Eligible non-study counties have complete 2001-2024 data and 2007 population between 0.35 and 2.5 times Caldwell.
Five lowest pretrend-RMSE donors are 36053, 26059, 47099, 28081 and 23013.
The result is descriptive and not a causal effect.

limitations: Nominal all-industry wages are not data-center wages or resident earnings.
Concurrent industrial restructuring and later expansions confound attribution.
Treatment-anchor sensitivity ranges from 3.7300979826653924 percent at 2007 to 9.600412546339765 percent at 2008; 2008 may already include opening effects.
Matching does not establish parallel untreated potential outcomes.
estimates.notes: Retained as a descriptive county comparison only after direct payroll/wage searches; not Google payroll and not a causal effect.

estimates.label: Cumulative City Technology Business taxes abated, FY2018-FY2025

scope.label: City of Lenoir Technology Business tax-abatement agreement associated with Google/Tapaha

interval.interpretation: Exact arithmetic sum of the eight City-reported annual abatement flows for FY2018-FY2025; the point interval expresses arithmetic identity, not independent certainty about taxpayer attribution.

estimates.confidence_rationale: All eight fiscal-year values and arithmetic are exact in official City ACFRs. Confidence is limited because the GASB 77 notes name only Technology Business, while Google/Tapaha attribution relies on the separately documented agreement.
estimates.decision_relevance: Provides the reproducible cumulative City abatement scale for the requested FY2018-FY2025 window without converting annual flows into receipts or a net-fiscal result.

evidence_search.remaining_evidence_gap: The annual notes do not name the taxpayer; County incentives, gross project tax receipts and same-scope marginal public costs remain incomplete.

assumptions: Each component is included exactly once and refers to a distinct fiscal year.
The scope follows the City Technology Business series and separately disclosed Google/Tapaha agreement attribution.
The adjacent FY2017 amount is excluded because the requested cumulative window begins in FY2018.
City-wide release schedules, County incentives, gross taxes, the $6.88 million deferred-contract balance and all assessed-value stocks are excluded.

limitations: The GASB 77 notes do not name the taxpayer.
This is a sum of abatements, not taxes paid, government receipts, public cost or net fiscal contribution.
FY2017 is a separate adjacent direct observation outside this model's period.
Do not add this cumulative total to any of its annual components.
estimates.notes: Exact, noncanonical arithmetic convenience total for FY2018-FY2025. It is non-additive with the eight annual claims and does not close the County incentive, gross-receipt, marginal-cost or net-fiscal gaps.

estimates.label: Tapaha real-property taxable value across nine public appraisal parcels

scope.label: Nine Tapaha Dynamics real-property parcels on Caldwell County accounts 132226 and 137489

interval.interpretation: Exact arithmetic sum of nine same-tax-year parcel values; not a tax, bill, payment, investment or market valuation.

provenance.detail: Exact sum of the six tax-year-2027 direct parcel claims on account 132226
Exact sum of the three tax-year-2027 direct parcel claims on account 137489

estimates.confidence_rationale: All nine components are exact same-tax-year values from official Caldwell County appraisal cards and reproduce both account subtotals and the overall sum.
estimates.decision_relevance: Provides the current public real-property taxable-value boundary for the Tapaha-owned campus and adjacent expansion parcels while keeping Google business-personal property and tax flows separate.

evidence_search.remaining_evidence_gap: The public cards do not disclose Google business-personal property, parcel-level levy, City jurisdiction, exemptions, tax bill, payment status or historical continuity with ACFR taxpayer rows.

derivation.formula: $446,161,900 account 132226 parcel subtotal + $87,721,700 account 137489 parcel subtotal = $533,883,600
assumptions: The nine public parcel rows are distinct and exhaust the Tapaha-named rows returned for accounts 132226 and 137489 on the retrieval date.
No Google business-personal property or non-Tapaha parcel is added.
The sum is not a tax, bill, payment, investment or building allocation.

limitations: Real-property parcels only; Google business-personal property is excluded.
The cards do not establish levy, exemption, City jurisdiction, bill or payment status.
The 914 Virginia appraisal is not equated with LNR4A because the public floor-area figures differ and no crosswalk was found.
Do not add this parcel total to historical ACFR Google-plus-Tapaha totals.
estimates.notes: Exact arithmetic convenience total for the nine tax-year-2027 Tapaha real-property parcel claims. It is not a tax, payment, investment or continuation of the historical combined taxpayer series.
